plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Biology Major (BS) program page (poid=886). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate lab corequisites in the catalog (BIOL 100L, BIOL 101L, BIOL 205L, BIOL 210L, BIOL 310L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, CHEM 201L, CHEM 202L, PHYS 210L, PHYS 220L), each printed at 0 Hour(s); the 0-credit labs are disclosed here and are not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', and CHEM 110L's detail prints 'Lab component of XXX 111'; no such course exists in the catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite. The catalog states the BS major is a minimum of eighteen courses, including at least ten biology courses, but prints no total semester-hour figure for the major; the recorded total (65) is the exact sum of the itemized requirements at their printed minimums: fixed courses sum to 52, the statistics slot is recorded at 4, and the three Biology elective slots are recorded at the catalog's printed minimum of 9 hours total (3 each). The statistics choice is printed as one of BIOL 205 Biological Statistics (4 Hour(s)), MATH 107 Statistical Methods with R (4 Hour(s)) or PSYC 201 Statistics with SPSS (3 Hour(s)); the slot lists the two 4-credit options at its exercised value, and a completion using PSYC 201 totals 64. The catalog lists the mathematics requirement as MATH 100 Calculus I 'or higher'; it is recorded as MATH 100 (4 Hour(s)). Catalog wording discrepancy, transcribed as printed and not resolved: the program introduction says 'at least ten biology courses' while the residency line says 'six of the 11 biology courses required for the major (BS) must be taken at Salem' — the count is 11 only when BIOL 205 is the statistics choice (7 named biology courses + BIOL 205 + 3 electives) and 10 otherwise. The catalog's advisory paragraph recommends the electives BIOL 235 Microbiology with Lab and BIOL 218/BIOL 219 Anatomy and Physiology I/II with Lab for the junior or senior year; the recommendation is disclosed here, and the elective slots themselves are not restricted to those courses.
